original: WPRPLACE is a national park in Arendal Municipality, Tvedestrand Municipality and Grimstad Municipality in Agder county in southeastern Norway. It is mostly a marine park, and includes some islands and coastal areas. Raet covers an area of 607 km2, of which 599 km2 is sea and 8 km2 is land. The park was established on 16 December [dated source].
translated: WPRPLACE ist ein Nationalpark in der Gemeinde Arendal, der Gemeinde Tvedestrand und der Gemeinde Grimstad im Kreis Agder im Südosten Norwegens. Dezember gegründet [datiert Quelle].
